in_marathi.name: Dharmi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Dharma or righteousness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharmi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit root ‘dhar’, meaning to support or uphold. Dharmi symbolizes the fundamental principles of truth, duty, and morality. In Hindu mythology, Dharmaraja is the God of righteousness and duty.
